sources.entry: SuperSEO Skills by sanderbz - A nice package of Claude Skills focused on SEO workflows: page audits, content briefs, article writing, E-E-A-T audits, semantic gap analysis, and more. Each skill fetches the target page and reads the top-ranking competitors itself, so users don't paste in keyword exports or crawl reports.

summary.one_liner: A set of 11 Claude Skills that run SEO workflows (page audits, content briefs, articles, E-E-A-T audits, semantic gap analysis, link plans) from a single URL or keyword, with the agent doing its own competitor research.
summary.what_it_does: Each skill lives in its own folder with a SKILL.md and a bundled references/ subfolder of templates and methodology material. Given a URL or keyword, the agent fetches the page or searches Google, reads the top-ranking competitors itself, and produces output such as a 7-dimension page audit, a writer-ready content brief, a complete SEO article, or a 90-day keyword ranking plan. Other skills cover rewriting existing pages, semantic gap analysis against the top 3 results, E-E-A-T scoring with fixes, hub-and-spoke topic cluster planning, featured snippet answer rewrites, phase-based link-building tactics, and expert interviews to extract first-party expertise. The README says the repo contains no executable code; the skills are Markdown prompts. Link-building playbooks and some additional tactics are referenced as living in a separate paid platform (InhouseSEO) that the README promotes, and the README says that platform handles historical Search Console data and monitoring, which the skills do not.
use_cases: audit a page for SEO against competitors
write a content brief from a target keyword
plan topic clusters and publishing order
find missing entities and subtopics versus top results
optimize a page to win a featured snippet
how_to_run: git clone <repo-url> && cp -r superseo-skills/skills/* ~/.claude/skills/  (manual Claude Code install; restart Claude Code afterward)
Claude.ai / Desktop: upload each skill zip via Settings → Features → Skills (Pro plan or above, one at a time)
Cursor: copy each skills/*/SKILL.md into .cursor/rules/ as a .md file
notable: Each skill takes one input (URL or keyword) and performs its own SERP and competitor research, with no CSV or crawl-export pasting
Claude Code plugin install adds all 11 skills in one command
Bundled per-skill references include 23 content-type templates with heading structure, schema, and word count targets
Includes an anti-AI-slop writing ruleset and a 9-playbook link-building reference set with safety guides for anchor text and link velocity
No executable code; the security surface is only the Markdown files
caveats: Claude.ai and Desktop skill upload is one skill per upload and requires a Pro plan or above; skills do not sync across surfaces
Cursor rule files are static, so the agent cannot load sibling reference files dynamically; references must be pasted in or grepped manually
The README says historical Search Console data, site monitoring, and 9 additional link-building playbooks are only in the separate InhouseSEO platform (free 14-day trial, then paid)
